title: Creator explainer: one-word captions + glossy icon cards over a split talking head (Tesseract review)
summary: A 72 s vertical creator reel reviewing an AI video-editing tool. It alternates between (A) full-frame selfie talking head with one-word white captions on the chest and (B) a 'stage' layout: soft grey metallic gradient background, a big glossy 3D-ish icon or UI card in the top third, a single black caption word in the middle, and the speaker cropped into a rounded card in the bottom half. A few pure-graphic beats drop the speaker entirely. The editing claim is that the whole video was made by an AI agent.
fit_reason: Template for Andrew's tool explainers: real speaker, one-word captions, and a stage layout where a product screenshot/icon card carries the value above him. The neutral grey stage looks premium and is easy to rebrand in navy.

palette.mood: neutral silver/grey metallic gradient (light top-left #D3D3CC to darker #545454 corners) with faint diagonal hairline texture; colour only from icon cards (yellow text on dark glass, Claude orange, purple/pink app icons)

typography.display: SF Pro Display / Inter Bold-Semibold, tight tracking (-2%)
typography.case: lowercase as spoken (proper nouns capitalised: 'Mirage', 'AI agent')
typography.size_behaviour: one word big: ~5% frame height (~95 px on 1920) on the footage layout, ~6% on the grey stage layout
typography.notes: Two caption colourways: white with soft dark drop shadow over footage; near-black #111 with no shadow over the grey stage. Glossy card text: 'TESSERACT' in yellow-lime pixel/bold caps with bullet list (VIDEO, LAYERS, TIMING, KEYFRAMES, MASKS, EFFECTS, AUDIO) on a dark rounded glass card; 'claude' cards in white with orange asterisk.

text_animation: single-word hard swap exactly on each word onset (no pop, no fade); 1 word, sometimes 2 short words grouped ('that AI', 'code up', 'by hand', 'so now', 'in the', 'I made it')
card text inside UI cards types/lists in item by item (bullet list builds line by line, synced to spoken list 'layers, timing, keyframes, masks')
caption sits in front of incoming cards (cards slide up behind the word)
captions: word-by-word (1 word on screen, sometimes 2). Footage layout: white bold sans, soft shadow, no box, centred at ~83% of frame height (chest). Stage layout: black bold sans, no box, centred at ~45-50% height between icon card above and speaker card below. Each word appears on its whisper onset and stays until the next word (e.g. 'generate' 2.46-2.68, 'images' 2.68-3.42). No highlight colour; emphasis comes from the layout/card changes, not caption styling.
motion: glossy icon/UI cards rise from below with motion blur and settle with slight overshoot (~0.25 s)
speaker card scales from full-frame into a rounded bottom card (layout morph)
punch-in zoom cuts on the speaker (alternating ~100% and ~120% framing)
screen-recording of a timeline editor with cursor dragging keyframes (B-roll above speaker)
transitions: warm peach/cream light-leak flash between sections (e.g. ~11.3 s, ~13.8 s)
hard cut to graphics-only beat (speaker removed) for emphasis words like 'the dead' / 'graphics' / 'in the'
graphic_elements: glossy 3D-style app icons (photos, play button, film strip, magnifier, editor timeline)
dark glass UI cards with yellow text
Claude chat-style cards with orange asterisk
grey metallic gradient with diagonal hairline texture
ui_treatment: rebuilt glossy cards summarising the product (feature list, chat prompt, 'Ready! download file'), plus real screen recording of a timeline editor above the speaker

pacing.hold_time_s: 2-5 s per layout; caption word 0.2-0.6 s

sound.voiceover: yes, on-camera creator, conversational, problem -> tool -> demo -> 'I made this video this way' -> CTA
sound.sync: captions per word; cards land on the noun being said ('images', 'agent', 'tools', 'claude', 'layers', 'mp4')

signature_moves: one-word captions that flip colour (white on footage, black on grey stage)
grey metallic 'stage' layout: icon card top, word middle, speaker card bottom
glossy icon cards that pop in exactly on the spoken noun
graphics-only beats where the speaker disappears for one phrase

best_segments.what: full-frame talking head, white one-word captions, glossy photo + play icons pop in on 'images' / 'videos'
grey stage layout: black word caption, TESSERACT feature card rises and lists items, claude card on 'claude'
list 'layers, timing, keyframes, masks' with card bullets building in sync over full-frame speaker
graphics-only beats: film-strip icon + 'the dead' / 'graphics' / 'in the', speaker removed then returns

recreate.how: Remotion: whisper word timestamps -> one <Caption> per word (white+shadow on footage, #111 on stage); scene list with layout per segment (footage | stage | graphic-only); stage = CSS radial/linear grey gradient + repeating-linear-gradient hairlines; speaker video in rounded div (border-radius 48px) bottom half; icon/UI cards as PNG/HTML with spring y from +200px + blur. Peach light-leak overlay on section changes.
recreate.prompt: Vertical talking-head explainer. Alternate full-frame speaker with one-word white bold captions at chest height, and a light grey metallic stage where a glossy product card sits at the top, one black bold word in the middle, and the speaker in a rounded card below. Cards rise in exactly on the spoken noun; warm light-leak flashes between sections.
